{
  "source": "https://github.com/BoardUI/boardui",
  "revision": "3e76e282614b147a34b9b2a510e31b97d58a3909",
  "license": "MIT",
  "scope": [
    "components/application/agent-chat",
    "components/application/agent-thinking",
    "components/application/composer-loader",
    "components/base",
    "components/foundations",
    "styles",
    "utils"
  ],
  "adaptations": [
    "Repository import paths point to components/boardui",
    "Neutral primary and ghost actions, restrained feedback, and readable agent surface tokens",
    "Focusable native actions support React Aria tooltip composition",
    "Icon-only child SVG fallback preserves explicit leadingIcon precedence",
    "The Agent Chat starter always uses the bundled local demo transport; API probing, provider keys, dashboard navigation, and Pro promotion are omitted",
    "Agent Chat imports resolve through components/boardui and its account logout action closes the local menu instead of navigating to a starter-only route",
    "The gallery chat uses a responsive history drawer below xl; selecting a thread, clicking outside, or pressing Escape closes it",
    "The prior pinned base components are unchanged at the current revision"
  ]
}

{
  "name": "Beautiful UI",
  "repository": "https://github.com/slev12397/beautiful-ui",
  "revision": "ff0f74d62d8be9d89bcb735b3632e31a6ccf88dc",
  "license": "MIT",
  "copyright": "Copyright (c) 2026 Shane Levine",
  "families": 21,
  "adaptation": "Original primitives and internal building blocks retain their APIs and interactions. The gallery uses Agents Kit fixtures; Beautiful UI theme utilities compile through the main Tailwind stylesheet. Shared semantic colors, readable tertiary text, neutral focus, and Inter/JetBrains Mono typography follow the Agents Kit design contract. Proprietary Iconists icons use Lucide equivalents. Existing root adapters remain available. Selection Actions uses a contained two-row toolbar on narrow hosts, while retaining the desktop floating toolbar."
}
